conclusion.explanation: Releasing ownership alone does not guarantee a native redraw. The repeat had no observed native failure during the claim, and successful later status queries did not refresh lighting. Static code inspection identifies lighting deduplication as a plausible explanation; the event that ultimately triggered the native redraw was not established.

limitations: Acknowledgements alone do not prove visible rendering or exact restoration of every LED parameter.
This test uses the existing Codex AG layer, not the F13-F18 Claude layer.
Native thread-lighting acknowledgement followed release by 8.111 seconds in the first trial and 75.735 seconds in the repeat; these are log timings, not timed physical observations.
The operator confirmed automatic native restoration only for the repeat, and did not separately confirm the exact six-color pattern.
Automatic layer ownership, Claude status collection, and routing safety have not been implemented or tested here.
The earlier unexplained USB disconnects remain recorded separately in hid-seize-test-20261006.json.
